LESSON: ISLAMIC ETIQUETTES

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.1: Islamic etiquettes

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Islamic etiquettes. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should we use (4 Lessons) on greetings to inculcate greetings Islamic gretings?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate the use of  Learners to salute and respond to Islamic greetings to attain greetings through role play rewards

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: ISLAMIC ETIQUETTES
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Islamic etiquettes helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: ISLAMIC ETIQUETTES
Study Islamic etiquettes like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Appreciate the use of  Learners to salute and respond to Islamic greetings to attain greetings through role play rewards

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the use of  Learners to salute and respond to Islamic greetings to attain greetings through role play rewards. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the use of  Learners to salute and respond to Islamic greetings to attain greetings through role play rewards.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Islamic etiquettes” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the use of  Learners to salute and respond to Islamic greetings to attain greetings through role play rewards. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Islamic etiquettes is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Islamic etiquettes” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: appreciate the use of  Learners to salute and respond to Islamic greetings to attain greetings through role play rewards)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Islamic etiquettes to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: appreciate the use of  Learners to salute and respond to Islamic greetings to attain greetings through role play rewards.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Islamic etiquettes from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Islamic etiquettes: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 1 learner study Islamic etiquettes?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should we use (4 Lessons) on greetings to inculcate greetings Islamic gretings?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Islamic etiquettes means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: appreciate the use of  Learners to salute and respond to Islamic greetings to attain greetings through role play rewards.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
